messages:
incidents-bot: ALERT: /v1/generate streaming p99 latency exceeded 4.0s (SLO breach). Metric source: streaming-tail-monitor. Paging on-call @mira.

mira: I'm on it. pulling up traces and logs.

mira: p95 is 1.1s, p99 jumped to 4.6s at 09:07 UTC. Error rate unchanged. Clients reporting long stalls between chunks; some sessions time out after 30s.

tom: any recent infra or preproc/template changes in the last deploy window?

priya: rolled prompt-hydrator v3.7 at 08:55 UTC. It changed caching semantics for prompt templates and disabled the lazy-tool-schema path for JSON-mode. Rolling that change back now.

mira: traces show long GC pauses in preproc service and many goroutine stacks stuck in `PromptBuilder.expandTemplate` calling `Tokenizer.tokenizeSchema()` repeatedly for nested tool entries. Example stack snippet:
```
prompt_hydrator/expand.go:112 expandTemplate
preproc/tokenizer/schema_tokenizer.go:88 tokenizeSchema
preproc/streaming_writer.go:199 flushChunk
runtime/gc.go:431 GC pause
```

oscar: queue depth for preproc increased from baseline 40 -> 320. CPU spiking on a few nodes to 98%. Heap allocs up 4x.

devops-bot: HPA alert: preproc hpa not scaling due to stale metrics exporter (metrics-server lagging).

emily: looks like templates with many nested tool references cause repeated tokenization of identical schema fragments because caching was bypassed by the hydrator change. That explains superlinear cost.

mira: mitigation plan: 1) flip `hydrator.enable_eager_schema` flag off 2) re-enable lazy schema path for streaming sessions 3) increase preproc replicas and restart the worst nodes 4) add short-term tokenization rate limit for sessions with >50 tools.

priya: running flag toggle: `POST https://admin.internal/flags/hydrator.enable_eager_schema {"value":false}`

priya: revert deploy started for prompt-hydrator (v3.7 -> v3.6). rollout tracker: https://deploys.internal/roll/10012

mira: scaling preproc: `kubectl scale deploy/preproc -n infra --replicas=8` (from 2). also restarting 3 nodes with >95% CPU.

oscar: metrics note: KV cache hit-rate dropped from 87% -> 54% during spike. repeated tokenization bypassed cache.

emily: implemented temporary guard in tokenizer to dedupe schema tokens per-session while rollback completes. patch applied directly to running cluster via hotfix.

mira: after mitigations p99 dropped to 1.5s within 5 minutes. queue depth normalized. marking status as mitigated but still in investigation.

incidents-bot: Severity escalated to Sev2 at 09:18 UTC. Incident ID: INC-2089.

mira: RCA hypothesis: prompt-hydrator change removed a small cache-check to favor correctness for edge-case schemas, but caused repeated tokenization for large nested tool sets in JSON-mode streaming sessions. Cost grows O(n^2) when templates reference repeating sub-schemas. Result: CPU/Garbage spikes, streaming tail stalls, p99 breach.

priya: next steps: patch to restore cache+guard, add per-session dedupe, introduce a cap `max_tokenized_schema_nodes=300`, and add early-exit when streaming=true. PR: https://git.internal/pr/4620. will cherry-pick to stable after review.

oscar: monitoring actions: add gauge `session_schema_nodes` and alert if >250 for any single session; add HPA fallback to external metrics exporter; lower HPA CPU threshold to 60%.

mira: customer impact: ~200 streaming sessions experienced stalls, mainly enterprise customers using long multi-tool prompts. No data corruption; partial responses for some sessions. SLA affected: streaming p99 SLO missed for ~16 minutes.

emily: customer comms: drafted priority notice for affected accounts and CSMs. will wait for final RCA before external notification.

mira: on-call handoff: I'll prepare a concise runbook update and hand to tom in 30m. Owners: Hotfix & RCA - priya, Monitoring - oscar, Customer comms - emily.

tom: taking over after handoff. remind to include the representative problematic prompt (sanitized) and timeline in postmortem. also recommend a longer-term change: stream tokenization progress so streaming writers can emit partial chunks even when tokenization is heavy.

incidents-bot: rollback completed at 09:32 UTC; hotfix patch live at 09:35 UTC. Canary healthy.

oscar: metrics after fix: heap allocs down ~45%, KV hit-rate restored to 88%, p99 back to target.

mira: closing live mitigation. post-incident actions: 1) merge PR 4620 to stable 2) deploy schema node gauge and alert 3) update prompt-hydrator test suite with large nested-tool templates 4) add runbook entry for schema-heavy prompts.

incidents-bot: Incident INC-2089 resolved at 09:48 UTC. Duration: 41m. Please add RCA, timeline, and action items to the incident ticket.

mira: thanks everyone. handing off to tom for tomorrow's follow-ups. good job all :raised_hands:
